quotes.text: A brand is not what you say it is. It's what they say it is.
quotes.author: Marty Neumeier

quotes.text: If it doesn't sell, it isn't creative.
quotes.author: David Ogilvy

quotes.text: Design is the silent ambassador of your brand.
quotes.author: Paul Rand

quotes.text: Products are made in the factory, but brands are created in the mind.
quotes.author: Walter Landor

quotes.text: Nobody reads advertising. People read what interests them. Sometimes it's an ad.
quotes.author: Howard Gossage

quotes.text: If your advertising goes unnoticed, everything else is academic.
quotes.author: Bill Bernbach

quotes.text: Your brand is what other people say about you when you're not in the room.
quotes.author: Jeff Bezos

About.label: Who we are
About.body1: Wexo was born from the real estate market — one of Brazil's most demanding in terms of speed and results. What we learned there: brand matters far more than the sector believes.
About.body2: Today we carry that conviction to companies in any segment that want to stop competing for attention and start deserving it.
About.member1Bio: +20 years of communication, with projects developed in Brazil's leading agencies, serving international brands such as Samsung, GM, Embraer, Bradesco, Terra, among others. Specialist in project and team management, digital development, and creative leadership. Gold and Silver winner at Wave Festival.
About.member2Bio: +30 years of Branding projects with +500 brands created for major market players, specialist in Branding and Creation, responsible for producing materials for launches, trade shows, events and external communication.
About.value1: Brand is not visual identity. It's the difference between being <accent>chosen</accent> and being <strike>compared</strike>.
About.value2: Most companies don't need <strike>more</strike> communication. They need <accent>more precise</accent> communication.
About.value3: An agency that never disagrees with clients isn't a partner. It's a <accent>supplier</accent>.
